sources.evidence: int index() const returns index_; storage is int index_. ELEMENT and HIDDEN are the allowed indexed kinds.
ELEMENT/HIDDEN use edge->index(), other kinds GetStringId(edge->name()); numeric label is written with AddNumber independently of to_node_index.
Writes numeric value using std::to_chars; it does not treat it as a string-table or target offset.
Official V8 processor converts ELEMENT/HIDDEN numeric labels directly to str; other numeric names index strings. Its comment warns documentation for name_or_index is wrong.
